title: Pro Tour Collector Set: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Followers of Tourach regarded all other religions equally: with open contempt. Not so the followers of Leitbur, who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.
"The powers of the corrupt will fade before the fury of the pure." —Bethan Leitbur, "The Way"
"Trained to battle the followers of Tourach, the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with Orcish and Goblin raiders." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*
"Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"Living side by side with the Elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess." —Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
Hardened by their life in the haunted Llanowar Forest, these fierce beings are outcasts among elvenkind.
Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.
"I hear there are Bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear." —Grandmother Sengir
Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.
"Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?" —Mairsil, called the Pretender
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them." —Baron Sengir
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, Dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*
It's bigger than it thinks.
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!" —Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!" —Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald
"…There was no trace Of aught on that illumined face…." —Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice." —Zur the Enchanter
"Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*
"There are intriguing similarities between the Order and Icatia's Leitbur religion, suggesting the two had a common origin." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*
Dedicated to the principles of Tourach, members of the Order of the Ebon Hand demonstrated their devotion with grisly rituals.
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal." —Baris, Serra Inquisitor
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither." —Leshrac, Walker of Night
"Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost." —Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald
"All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*
Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the Rack was once his most feared creation.
Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.
"The eerie, wailing Hymn caused insanity even in hardened warriors." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*
Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.
Members of the Order often played the Hymn on instruments made from their victims' bones.
A true follower of Tourach took pride in achievement to the exclusion of other concerns.
Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.
This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystical runes.
"Oh, they scream, right enough, and plead, too—but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad." —Disa the Restless, journal entry
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal." —Reyhan, Samite Alchemist
The legacy of Feroz lives on.
"On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.
"No one can catch what won't be caught." —Kakra, Sea Troll
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage
Up and down, over and through, back around— the joke's on you.
The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn." —Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"
Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.
D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact. The fight was getting ugly.
"Although fragile, the Aeolipile could be quite destructive." —*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains." —Grandmother Sengir
"The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce." —Eron the Relentless
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"Oh, I had a conscience once. But alas, I seem to have forgotten where I put it." —Chandler
"Um … oh … what was I saying?" —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"I have my faith, and I have my prayers. But if push comes to shove, I've also got a little something extra." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest
